title: AI & Technology Engineering
tagline: LLM foundations, RAG pipelines, AI agents (MCP), fine-tuning (LoRA/DPO), and production LLMOps.
description: Master technical interview questions and systems architectures for modern AI Engineers, GenAI Developers, and LLM Platform Architects. Sourced directly from Amit Shekhar's comprehensive AI Engineering curriculum.
source_license: Public Open Source (Outcome School / Amit Shekhar)

categories.name: LLM Fundamentals & Transformer Mechanics
categories.description: Transformer self-attention, tokenization algorithms (BPE), sparse architectures (MoE), and KV-caching inference optimization.

categories.name: Prompt Engineering, In-Context Learning & Guardrails
categories.description: In-context learning paradigms (few-shot, CoT, ReAct), structured output generation, and LLM security guardrails.

categories.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Systems
categories.description: Vector embeddings, hybrid retrieval (dense + sparse), chunking strategies, reranking models, and contextual RAG pipelines.

categories.name: AI Agents, Tool Calling & Model Context Protocol (MCP)
categories.description: Autonomous agent loops, tool calling interfaces, episodic memory architectures, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) standards.

categories.name: Fine-Tuning, Quantization & Model Alignment (RLHF / DPO)
categories.description: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), post-training quantization (AWQ, GGUF), and preference alignment (DPO, RLHF).

categories.name: AI System Design, Production Serving & LLMOps
categories.description: Production LLM serving architectures, vLLM continuous batching, semantic caching, automated evaluation, and hallucination monitoring.
